matthews-paint.name: Matthews Paint
matthews-paint.what: Acrylic polyurethane paint made for signs, sprayed on aluminum, acrylic and other sign materials.
matthews-paint.use: Every painted part: returns, faces, backers, raceways, cabinets

sherwin-williams.name: Sherwin-Williams
sherwin-williams.what: Architectural paint. Its color numbers are how architects, landlords and brands name the colors of a building.
sherwin-williams.use: Reading a wall, fascia or brand color, then matching sign paint to it. The sign itself is sprayed in Matthews Paint.

pantone.name: Pantone
pantone.what: The Pantone Matching System (PMS): a numbered library of ink colors that printers, brands and manufacturers all share.
pantone.use: Reading a client's brand colors, then matching paint and vinyl to them. We don't buy anything from Pantone but its guides.

tables.title: Libraries
rows: The spot ink printed on glossy coated paper. The one brand guides usually give, and the one sign work uses.
The same ink on plain uncoated paper. It looks duller and often lighter.
The closest four-color (CMYK) print of each solid color, beside the solid. For anything printed digitally.

3m.name: 3M Films
3m.what: Colored vinyl film with adhesive on the back, cut to shape and applied to a sign face.
3m.use: Translucent film on lit acrylic faces and push-thru letters; opaque film for graphics that aren't lit from behind

tables.title: Film Series
rows: The standard film for lit faces. Vinyl, 2 mil thick, with a clear permanent adhesive.
Made for faces lit by LEDs. Its color numbers end in `L`.
Cut graphics with a permanent adhesive. Cuts and weeds down to 1/4" letters.
Like 7725. Cuts and weeds down to 3/8" letters.
Slides into place before it's pressed down, and lets trapped air out. For large graphics and wraps.
A separate, shorter color range with its own numbers.
Five fluorescent colors, in this series only.

eastern-metal-supply.name: Eastern Metal Supply
eastern-metal-supply.what: An aluminum distributor: sheet and plate, standard and custom extrusions, and a line of extrusions made for signs.
eastern-metal-supply.use: The metal of a sign: faces, backs, returns, backers, cabinets and raceways
